event_summary: 1854年2月、シューマンは自らを苦しめていた幻聴の旋律を「天使からの啓示」と信じて書き留め、妻クララに捧げる変奏曲(いわゆる『幽霊変奏曲』)として作曲した。だがその旋律は、以前に自作した旋律とほぼ同じものだった。その直後に彼は心の病に倒れて自ら療養所に入り、1856年に世を去った。
hook_copy: 妻への[G]最後の愛の曲[/G]は、[R]幻聴が歌った旋律[/R]から生まれた
portrait_prompt: Portrait of the German composer Robert Schumann, based on the 1839 Kriehuber lithograph. A young man in his late twenties with a soft, rounded, youthful face, fair/pale skin, and a gentle, thoughtful gaze turned slightly toward the viewer. He has thick, wavy medium-length dark brown hair swept back and to the side with loose curls framing the forehead and ears, no beard or mustache, clean-shaven. He wears a dark double-breasted coat with a high upturned collar and a voluminous dark silk cravat tied loosely at the neck, in the fashion of the 1830s. Bust-to-shoulder composition, three-quarter view. Plain, neutral, almost monochrome background. Illustrated cinematic style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. No text, no signature. Artwork fills the entire frame edge-to-edge, no border, no vignette, no empty margin around the edges.

middle_slides.text: 1854年2月、ドイツの作曲家ロベルト・シューマンは、ピアニストの妻クララとの幸せな家庭の裏で、原因不明の耳鳴りと幻聴に悩まされていた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: An oil-painting style illustration of composer Robert Schumann in his mid-forties, seated at home in a cozy 19th-century German parlor, looking tired and distracted, pressing a hand lightly to his temple or ear as if hearing a faint ringing sound. He has the same soft rounded face as his youth but now with thinning dark brown hair receding slightly at the temples and faint lines of fatigue on his face, no beard. In the warmly lit background, his wife Clara Schumann sits at a piano, happily playing, unaware of his distress — a contrast between domestic warmth and his inner torment. Soft candlelight, muted warm colors, painterly brushwork, not photorealistic. No text.

middle_slides.text: 同年2月、彼は「天使が授けた」と信じた旋律を書き留め、妻クララへ捧げる『幽霊変奏曲』を数日で書き上げた。だがそれは、以前自作した旋律と、ほぼ同じものだった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: An oil-painting style illustration of composer Robert Schumann, same rounded face with thinning wavy dark brown hair and a few streaks of grey at the temples, no beard, sitting at a wooden writing desk late at night in February, feverishly writing musical notation by candlelight with an intense, almost rapturous expression as if transcribing a melody dictated to him from beyond. Faint, ghostly glowing musical notes or soft angelic light subtly drifting in the air above the page, suggesting a hallucinated melody. Warm candle glow against dark shadows, dramatic chiaroscuro, painterly brushwork, not photorealistic. No text.

middle_slides.text: その直後、彼は心の病に倒れ、自ら望んで療養所に入った。2年後にその生涯を終えた。この変奏曲が、彼にとって最後の作品となった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: An oil-painting style illustration of composer Robert Schumann in his mid-forties, with exactly the same soft, rounded, full face and facial features as in the reference portrait (same broad cheeks, same eyes, nose and mouth), only slightly older, with a tired, sorrowful expression and a few grey streaks in his wavy dark brown hair, no beard, dressed in a simple dark coat, being gently led by attendants toward the entrance of a quiet countryside sanatorium building. Soft, melancholic grey-blue lighting, bare autumn trees in the background, a sense of quiet resignation and sorrow. Composition shows Schumann in three-quarter view with his face clearly visible, body and face turned the same direction. Painterly brushwork, muted tones, not photorealistic. No text.

fb_caption:
愛する妻へ贈られた最後の作品『幽霊変奏曲』には、ある秘密が隠されていた。シューマンが「天使の声」と信じたその旋律は、実は彼自身が以前に書いた曲だった🎹

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

他の作曲家の逸話も知りたい方は、チャンネルもチェックしてみてください。https://youtube.com/@classicalmusic_note?si=evg6wej2KOx2uPhH
